newsitem.title: USA: USWC prods fall with ample supply, daytime NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: USWC prods fall with ample supply, daytime NYMEX.

text.p: Prices for U.S. West Coast products eased Tuesday, reacting to lower energy futures and new data from the American Petroleum Institute (API) that showed growing gasoline supply in the region, traders said.
May crude oil on New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) eased 78 cents a barrel to $19.60 as barrel as traders sold their contracts before today's expiry.
May gasoline, which expires April 30, fell 1.03 cents a gallon to 61.95 cents a gallon.
Trade turned light late Tuesday, with traders showing "complete disinterest" in the APIs, one broker said.
